subject: Keystone Labs: Access & onboarding kickoff — SSO/SCIM/IP guardrails
messages:
From: Alex Reid <alex.reid@keystonelabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Keystone Labs access onboarding request

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the intro form. Keystone is ready to begin the access onboarding for our Redwood deployment next week. High level needs: SSO (Okta is our IdP), SCIM provisioning for users and groups, IP allowlist for outbound API calls, and a secure pattern for service accounts (short-lived creds preferred).

I've attached a spreadsheet with our initial inventory and a couple of compliance questions from our security lead (see tab "Compliance Qs"). Can you confirm who on your side will own the technical integration and who will handle SOC2 evidence requests? Also we want to schedule a 60-min kickoff to align on timelines (ideally next Tue/Wed).

Attaches: Keystone_Onboarding_Requirements.xlsx

Thanks,
Alex Reid
Sr. IT Program Manager
Keystone Labs
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@keystonelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone Labs access onboarding request

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Welcome aboard.

Quick answers up front: I’ll own the project as CSM/technical PM and will coordinate timelines with Ben (security lead) and Soojin (onboarding engineer) who I’ve CCed. We can cover SOC2 evidence and procurement coordination during the kickoff.

Proposed kickoff agenda (60 min):
- Introductions & scope (10m)
- IdP / SSO details (Okta metadata, SAML attributes) (10m)
- SCIM provisioning (attribute mapping & group sync cadence) (10m)
- Network constraints: IP allowlist & egress (10m)
- Service account pattern & rotation (10m)
- Next steps / mutual action plan (10m)

Before the call we need:
1) Confirm IdP type (you mentioned Okta) and whether you manage org-level SCIM or per-team SCIM.
2) Provide the IP ranges you plan to allow (CIDR list).
3) Confirm if you require per-tenant service accounts or a single shared service account with scoped roles.

I'll propose two slots in a separate calendar invite. Ben/Soojin — can you add anything to the technical checklist below before I send the invite?

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Customer Success Lead — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>, Alex Reid <alex.reid@keystonelabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone Labs access onboarding request

Thanks Lukas — adding the technical checklist.

Technical checklist (items to gather / pre-configure):
- SAML / SSO
  - IdP metadata XML (Okta metadata URL or file)
  - Required SAML attributes: email, given_name, family_name, groups (confirm group attribute)
  - SAML sign-on URL and SP entity ID (we'll provide)

- SCIM provisioning
  - SCIM base URL + auth token (we support token-based Bearer)
  - User & group attribute mapping sheet (we'll share a template)
  - Sync cadence expectations (near real-time vs nightly)

- IP allowlist
  - CIDR ranges that must be whitelisted (we will supply Redwood egress IPs for your list; you supply expected on-prem/office ranges if you limit incoming callbacks)

- Service accounts & secrets
  - Recommend: per-tenant service account that maps to a scoped service role. Prefer short-lived tokens (we support token rotation via our API).
  - If you need automation, we can provide a provisioning API key with RBAC scopes and a sample Terraform module.

- Compliance artifacts
  - SOC2 evidence request owner (provide contact)
  - Data retention policy questions — are you restricted to any specific retention windows?

I've attached the integration guide for the SCIM endpoints and sample SAML assertion mapping.

Attaches: redwood_scim_api_integration_guide.pdf

I'll be on the kickoff to run the deep technical section.

- Ben Carter
Security & Integrations Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@keystonelabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alex Reid <alex.reid@keystonelabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystone Labs access onboarding request

Thanks team — quick responses inline: 
- IdP: Confirmed Okta (org-level) — we will provide the metadata URL and an Okta admin who can generate the metadata.
- SCIM: Org-level provisioning preferred. We want groups synced for role mapping (engineering, security, finance). Nightly sync is fine to start.
- IP allowlist: Attaching our office/colocation egress ranges for staging (10.12.32.0/22, 10.13.0.0/18) and we will whitelist Redwood egress as soon as you share.
- Service accounts: We'd prefer per-tenant service accounts with automated rotation.

I've attached our PO and a short procurement note so legal/procurement can loop in. We are available for kickoff Wed 10/20 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 10/21 9:00–10:00 PT.

Attaches: Keystone_PO_4578.pdf

Cheers,
Marta Lopez
Head of IT Operations
Keystone Labs
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.inference.com>

Perfect — thanks Marta. Wed 10/20 10:00 PT works and I've sent the invite to the confirmed participants.

Action items / owners (short mutual action plan):

- Ben: share exact egress IPs and SCIM template; run SAML attribute review during kickoff
- Soojin: prepare Terraform sample for per-tenant service account provisioning + rotation example
- Keystone: provide Okta metadata URL, CIDR list for staging/prod, and PO contact for procurement (Marta)

Pre-read links: https://app.redwood-inference.com/mutual-action-plan/KSL-4578 (MAP), https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-keystone-kickoff-MAP

We'll reserve a 60-min slot and split the technical/operational segments so we can get to implementation decisions by EOD next week. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
